verdict.rationale: a-Shell includes a grep command (used e.g. in `help -l | grep command`) which supports basic regex-based filtering of text, but there is no evidence of fuzzy matching or dedicated code-navigation tooling (e.g. ripgrep, ctags, fzf-style fuzzy finder) for searching code content. missing for 10: fuzzy matching support, dedicated code search/navigation tool, evidence of regex search across code files beyond simple grep usage.
